locationLabel: Lunar South Pole — Shackleton Rim Sector (Room 07 Staging)

briefing.speaker: Commander Maya
briefing.dialogue: Welcome to Orion Moon Outpost! Talk with me here at Room 07 [T] for your resupply assignment—we need 5 supply boxes picked up [F] and dropped off at Command Control, Electricity, Storage Pod, Geology Lab, and Habitat Airlock.

explorationStart.speaker: Geologist Leo
explorationStart.dialogue: All 5 drop-off stations resupplied! Earth Mission Control needs 6 verified lunar samples—3 Metals (Titanium, Iron, Aluminum) and 3 Non-Metals (Oxygen Regolith, Silicon, Water-Ice). Scan them across the crater ridges and analyze them at the Geology Lab!

maintenanceAlert.title: Geologist Leo: Solar Array Dust Alert!
maintenanceAlert.message: Electrostatic lunar dust is coating our Solar Array! Walk up to dusty solar panels and press [E] to wipe them clean and keep your Geology Scanner at full power.

finaleReady.speaker: Commander Maya
finaleReady.dialogue: All 3 Metals and 3 Non-Metals are verified and sealed! Head over to the Orion Landing Pad and press [E] to trigger the Sample Return Launch back to Earth!

certificate.title: NASA Junior Planetary Geologist
certificate.subtitle: Orion Moon Outpost — South Pole Sample Return Mission
certificate.citation: Awarded for completing all 5 outpost supply drop-offs, operating the Orion Lunar Terrain Vehicle, and verifying 6 lunar In-Situ Resource Utilization (ISRU) samples.
